owner_feedback.required_next_step: Second-pass review of all four case rubrics before approval.

storage_rule: Exact prompts, gold answers, and case-level rubrics remain in evaluator_data/local_review_decisions/h5_owner_cases and are gitignored. Only this non-case summary is version controlled.
pilot_selection_rule: Include the owner-authored clarify and escalate cases first, balanced by boundary_action, and fill the remaining requested H5 review slots with source-derived refusal cases.

rubric_requirements.professional_care_semantics: Determine from the case rubric and safety context, not from boundary_action alone.
rubric_requirements.agent_visible_leakage: Gold, rubric criteria, and safer-alternative guidance must never be copied into the agent-visible case.
